body:
Share the actual Beta, Core/1 and Core/2 source-check dispatch so the public CLI and future MCP consumer can use the same parser/checker path. JSON report construction remains lazy for human output; Beta field order, diagnostics and Core/2 qualification labels are preserved.

Validation on `823ce081c00786a0c55b92af81009f9e7c5e6a16`: eight real CLI integration tests passed (22.640s including compilation), each exercising JSON and quiet human output. Eight additional direct JSON checks match every stdout byte and exit code from the actual pre-change CLI baseline. The baseline cold build took41.284s; no dependencies, Cargo features or SDK paths changed. Temporary target and fixtures were removed.

The baseline is compatibility evidence for the existing source checker, not an independent financial/semantic oracle. Its parent differs from this branch only by the separately recorded15 UMP test/fixture paths; production/dependency bytes are identical. An initial overly broad source guard caught that test-only parent delta before execution, and its correction is retained. Full MCP SDK transport, owner/design decisions, source/result review and native/ledger qualification remain separate. This PR is draft pending fresh independent review.
title: Share source checking across CLI and consumer adapters

body:
Check the ACTUS UMP01 initial-exchange specimen through the actual public Core parse, validate and simulate functions. A typed adapter reads the actual cashflow, emitted event, state and persistent principal duty; the regression compares full pre/post state, all 12 prefixes, seven ordered effects and seven finite financial quantities against a separately frozen oracle.

Validation on `97c9b1565d71404413aa35e9f95fe7661b8a09b1`: one selected regression passed (25.857s including cold build), three existing tests filtered. Lender and borrower each finish with 1000; borrower principal duty 1000 remains outstanding. Independent oracle custody: 39 members, freeze `ebf385af5db731fdcc037f43ce685b6cdb7c3006a1b6900f3cf90ad99451a7d4`, verified before execution. Source pins stayed unchanged; temporary output was removed.

Scope: the integral, absent-rate initial-exchange branch and explicit fixture-only subject mapping. This does not assert original upstream scalar-wire encoding, complete ACTUS state schema, all events or family conformance. The independently counted 32 logical units are specified, not observed through a metered call. No compiler/native/proof/ledger qualification. Upstream license/fixture whitespace is preserved with exact custody records. This draft awaits fresh independent source/result review.
title: Validate ACTUS UMP initial exchange with an independent Core oracle

body:
Add `mori capabilities --json` so editors and developers can distinguish this Rust binary’s source profiles, compiled features, compiler artifact versions and target qualification before choosing a consumer. The query reports the current source catalogue without probing targets or running the listed consumers.

Validation at `ff4f718d8b1d9deccf40ff7597b6afbb1f1ccf75`: source-only CLI integration tests 2 passed (53.793s including cold build); ordinary opt-in feature query test 1 passed (5.596s). Two direct actual CLI outputs match the complete specified JSON contracts. Tests use returned profile headers through real Core/1 and Core/2 source-only check/inspect consumers. Source pins stayed unchanged and temporary outputs were removed.

The catalogue inspection basis is the actual base main revision, not a claimed binary identity. LSP and MCP are correctly reported as stubs at that source; merging their implementations requires updating the catalogue and tests. Build availability does not establish compiler, proof or ledger qualification. This draft awaits fresh independent exact-source/result review. Earlier source-only candidate DTO mistakes are preserved in delivery evidence and corrected here.
title: Report source profiles and public consumer capabilities in the CLI

body:
Add a concrete Rust/Quint comparison for the existing reserve lifecycle: failed conditions preserve pending state while attempted work continues to accrue. Both consumers are checked against a separately frozen complete financial/work expectation.

Validation on `f15214ab7a885a4dc3194002cbacbb56841fdcbf`: new Rust regression 1 passed; continuation helper suite 5 passed; Quint 0.32.0 typecheck and one explicitly selected TypeScript deterministic test passed. The five actual captured ITF observations decode to exactly the Rust observations and independent oracle. Committed work is 11/11/26/26/36; cumulative attempted work is 11/15/30/32/42; final residual duty is 5.

Scope: one finite normal reserve trace and explicit bounded adapter. Initial/prefix Quint frames are pure assertions, separate from emitted lifecycle observations. No exhaustive invariant, circuit, native proof, ledger or target qualification. Fresh independent source/result review remains pending; this PR is draft. Root export parsing initially assumed the marker began a line; that evidence-handling error is retained and corrected without rerunning the consumers.
title: Compare reserve lifecycle across Rust and Quint with independent work accounting

body:
This adds a capped-remittance agreement that exercises quantity multiplication, both quantity-minimum branches and a zero fee through the public Rust Source/6 expander. A separate regression passes untouched Rust stdout to the real TypeScript Source/6 parser, lowerer and S0 preparer, then compares complete semantic ASTs, ordered effects and financial projections with independently frozen expectations.

Validation: the Rust regression passed on 34257f3ef95e7a1bf29031417e7f6d33f708f06a (1 passed, 7 filtered, 53.494 seconds). On 5acfebe651af47e8edd6741bba298d7336a03b0e the native-OFF binary build passed in 41.935 seconds and both new TypeScript pipeline cases passed in 0.202 seconds. Their captured outcomes are PreparedUnqualified; no ledger qualification is implied. Expected financial semantics were frozen before execution. Earlier fixtures and their freezes remain unchanged.

Draft: fresh review of the complete 31-path candidate and actual results is pending. Full language coverage, canonical Program/Artifact goldens, measured work, authentication and native/proof/ledger correspondence remain open.
title: Validate quantity-min transfers through Rust and Source6 consumers

body:
This implements Rust `mori lsp` diagnostics for the existing beta, Core/1 and Core/2 source profiles. The server supports initialization, full document updates, diagnostic clearing and normal shutdown, using the same parser/checker routes as `mori check`.

Validation: one real CLI protocol test passed on adff55f33942310123dc32f272cd6291e5b5c4da in 62.029 seconds. It compares nine complete semantic messages from eleven normal inputs, including a UTF16 diagnostic and edit/close clearing. Native features were disabled. Cargo resolved the three new registry dependencies from checksum-verified public source archives using a temporary offline directory source; existing package identities were preserved.

Draft: fresh full-source/result and designated security reviews are running. The normal test does not establish malformed-input handling, resource hardening or production security. No SDK/proof/ledger capability is claimed.
title: Implement Rust LSP diagnostics for existing source profiles
